about: The secreta of the formulary “Nativity of Saint John the Baptist” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We heap Your altar with gifts, O Lord, celebrating with due honor the birth of him who both foretold the coming of the Savior of the world and made His presence known: our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son. He lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,
